extracted.name: Homemade Tomato Juice Cocktail
extracted.description: Homemade tomato juice cocktail is ready with just 5 ingredients and is a fraction of the cost of store-purchased versions.
instruction_lines: Blend 2 cups water, tomato paste, lemon juice, sugar, and salt together in a blender until smooth; pour into a 1/2 gallon container. Stir 3 cups water into mixture. Refrigerate until thickened, about 1 hour. Add 1 more cup water if juice is too thick.
